niche.description:
🚨 $30 MILLION IN DRUGS FOUND IN A SEMI — BUT THE DRIVER WAS RELEASED?

U.S. Customs and Border Protection discovered approximately 3,400 pounds of suspected methamphetamine hidden in a commercial shipment of salt at the World Trade Bridge in Laredo, Texas.

Estimated street value? $30.4 MILLION!

But here’s what caught my attention: According to FreightWaves, the driver and equipment were reportedly released while the investigation continued.

So what did the driver know? Who arranged the shipment? And how can truck drivers protect themselves when hauling freight they didn’t personally load?
